notes:
Nocto 0.6.0: Linux
- First Linux release: AppImage for x86_64 (Wayland and X11, PipeWire, QuickSync/VAAPI/NVENC/software encoding)
- Same UI, editor, plugins and browser sources as Windows
- Linux limits: no game capture (use window capture), no in-app updater yet, HDR10 output is SDR only
- Windows x64 and ARM64 behave as in 0.5.3

linux-x64.label: Linux
linux-x64.requirements: Linux x86_64 (Wayland or X11, PipeWire, Mesa 24+ or NVIDIA driver)
linux-x64.install:
Install: download the AppImage, then run chmod +x Nocto-0.6.0-x86_64.AppImage and start it with ./Nocto-0.6.0-x86_64.AppImage.

Needs: a Wayland or X11 desktop with PipeWire and xdg-desktop-portal, and your distribution's GPU drivers (Mesa 24+ for Intel/AMD, or the NVIDIA proprietary driver). Recommended: GStreamer plugins-base and plugins-good for browser source audio; v4l2loopback for the virtual camera in Discord/Zoom. No in-app updater on Linux yet.
